title: Foundation-model embeddings in a differentiable hydrologic model
description:
A modified copy of the δMG differentiable modeling framework, adapted so that a differentiable rainfall-runoff model can take pretrained foundation-model embeddings as input. The frozen encoder is run once over the forcing record, the embedding is stored and optionally compressed by a learned condenser, and it is then fed to the HBV parameterization network through a small trainable adapter.

Includes the four-stage offline embedding pipeline, the CAMELS-531 and Caravan-3026 experiment configurations covering every component and ablation in the paper, three-seed SLURM job scripts, and the analysis scripts that produce the figures and tables.

Upstream framework: mhpi/generic_deltamodel. See CHANGES_VS_DMG.md for the file-level differences.
